issues.t: Front coil springs rust and snap (recall)
issues.sym: A loud bang or clunk over bumps, one front corner sitting lower than the other, a scraping noise near a front wheel, or a front tire that suddenly goes flat.
issues.why: Road salt eats into the front coil springs until one cracks. A broken spring end can rub through the inside of the tire. Nissan recalled cars sold or registered in salt-belt states and later added more 2012 hatchbacks.
issues.next: Run the VIN for recalls 15V-573 and 17V-637. If a spring is broken, do not drive the car on the highway; have both front springs replaced first.

issues.sym: A rising whine, hesitation or surging when pulling away, the engine revving without the car speeding up, or the car going into a weak limp mode.
issues.why: The early Jatco CVT in the first-generation Versa wears internally, especially when the fluid is old or the transmission runs hot. The conventional 4-speed automatic and the manual do not share this problem.
issues.next: Have the CVT fluid checked and the transmission scanned at the first sign of slipping. If the car loses drive or limps, stop driving it and have it towed.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off by a damaged sensor connector (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light stays on, or the passenger airbag is turned off even with an adult in the seat.
issues.why: On some early hatchbacks, the connector for the passenger seat belt tension sensor was damaged at the factory. That confuses the occupant detection system, which then shuts off the passenger front airbag.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 07V-094 and have the connector replaced. Until then, do not count on the passenger airbag working.

issues.sym: Shuddering or jerking when accelerating from a stop, a whining noise, slow response, or a transmission warning light with a loss of power.
issues.why: The small Jatco CVT in these cars can wear its belt, pulleys and valve body, and overheats more easily when worked hard. Class-action settlements stretched Nissan's CVT coverage on these years.
issues.next: Keep up with CVT fluid changes using the correct Nissan fluid, and ask a Nissan dealer whether any extended CVT coverage still applies. If the car loses drive, have it towed instead of driving it.

issues.t: Car can be shifted out of Park without pressing the brake (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter moves out of Park without your foot on the brake, so the car could roll unexpectedly.
issues.why: The shifter rod and knob can interfere with each other, which defeats the brake-shift interlock.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 12V-032. Until it is repaired, always set the parking brake and keep your foot on the brake when shifting.

issues.t: Side airbags can go off when a door is slammed (recall)
issues.sym: Side curtain airbags, seat airbags or belt pretensioners fire while the car is parked with the key on, often right after a door is shut hard. An airbag light may come on beforehand.
issues.why: Connector pins at the side-impact sensors are made of mismatched metals and can corrode, briefly cutting the sensor signal. The airbag computer can read that as a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 17V-144 and get the sensor and harness repair done promptly. Close doors gently until it is fixed.

issues.t: Console trim can catch the driver's shoe (recall)
issues.sym: Your right shoe snags on the lower edge of the center console when moving from the gas pedal to the brake.
issues.why: The lower console trim panel sits close to the pedals, and some shoes can catch on its edge, which can slow the move to the brake.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 15V-507; the dealer trims the panel. Until then, be aware of the snag point when braking.

issues.t: Passenger front airbag may not hold its shape (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning beforehand; the problem would show up only in a crash.
issues.why: A ring plate that holds the passenger front airbag cushion in place may not be secured properly, so the airbag may not protect the passenger as designed.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 17V-275 and have the repair done as soon as possible.

issues.t: Key can slip out of Run and stall the engine (recall)
issues.eng: Cars with a regular turn key (not push-button start)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving, often over bumps, and the key is found in the Accessory position. Power steering and brake assist are lost.
issues.why: Small springs inside the ignition switch can wear or break. With a heavy key ring and road vibration, the key can then turn out of Run on its own.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 18V-551. Until the switch is checked or replaced, take everything else off the key ring.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be blanked out by display settings (recall)
issues.sym: The rearview camera screen stays dark or shows no picture when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: If the screen display settings are changed a certain way, they can hide the camera image entirely.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 19V-654; the dealer updates the system. Use the mirrors and turn around to look until it is fixed.

issues.t: Front turn signal bulb can crack and go out (recall)
issues.sym: A front turn signal does not light, or the signal on the dash blinks fast.
issues.why: The front turn signal bulb can crack, so other drivers cannot see that you are turning.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 21V-471 and have the bulb replaced. Walk around the car to confirm all signals work.

issues.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: The power steering warning light comes on and the wheel suddenly becomes very heavy, especially at parking-lot speeds.
issues.why: A weak weld inside the steering torque sensor can lose contact, so the electric power steering shuts off and you are left steering by hand.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recalls 22V-693 and 23V-496. If the warning light comes on, drive slowly and get the car to a dealer.

issues.t: Engine start/stop button can stick and shut off the engine (recall)
issues.sym: On cars with push-button start, the engine switches off while driving, usually in hot weather, and steering and brake assist get heavy.
issues.why: Heat can make the start/stop button bind in its housing. A stuck button can act like it is being held down, which turns the engine off.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 15V-418 and have the switch housing modified. If the engine shuts off, steer to the side and restart once stopped.

issues.t: Fuel tank may develop a leak at the seam (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell around the rear of the car, a damp spot or drip under the tank, or a check engine light for the fuel vapor system.
issues.why: The wall of the fuel tank may have been formed too thin near a seam, where a small hole can open up.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 20V-112. Do not park in a garage or keep driving with a fuel smell until the tank is replaced.

issues.t: Driver airbag may not inflate correctly (recall)
issues.sym: There is usually no warning. The risk is a driver airbag that does not open properly in a crash.
issues.why: The driver airbag inflator on some cars can take in moisture over time, which changes how it fires.
issues.next: Check the VIN for recall 24V-154 and have the driver airbag assembly replaced.

issues.t: Dealer-installed portable navigation battery can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: The navigation unit gets very hot, swells, or gives off a hot plastic smell while charging in the car.
issues.why: A portable navigation unit sold and fitted with some of these cars has a lithium battery that can overheat, which brings a burn and fire risk.
issues.next: Stop using and charging the unit in the car. Check the VIN for this equipment recall and have the unit or its battery dealt with by the dealer.

issues.t: Side curtain airbag seam can tear when it deploys (recall)
issues.sym: Nothing shows up day to day; the problem would only appear in a side crash.
issues.why: A stitched seam in the side curtain airbag on a small batch of cars may be weak, so the airbag can tear instead of staying inflated and protecting heads in a rollover or side impact.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the side curtain airbag recall and have the module replaced. Build dates were narrow, so many cars are not affected.
